title.en: Google reports an AI response from its orbital TPU prototype
title.zhHans: Google 报告其在轨 TPU 原型生成了一条 AI 回复

searchSummary.en: On October 30, Google reported a test response from an onboard Gemma 4 model on its Project Suncatcher satellite.
searchSummary.zhHans: 谷歌于 10 月 30 日报告，Project Suncatcher 卫星上的 Gemma 4 模型在测试中生成了回复。

summary.en: Google reported on October 30 that its Project Suncatcher prototype satellite had sent back a response generated by an onboard Gemma 4 model running on a data-center-class TPU. The post says the team uplinked a prompt during a ground-station pass; it does not provide an exact test date. Google launched the satellite on October 1. This is a company-reported prototype milestone, not a functioning commercial space data center or independent validation of its performance.
summary.zhHans: 谷歌于 10 月 30 日报告，其 Project Suncatcher 原型卫星上运行于数据中心级 TPU 的 Gemma 4 模型生成了回复并传回地面。文章称团队在地面站过境期间上行了提示词，但未给出测试的确切日期。卫星于 10 月 1 日发射。这是公司报告的原型里程碑，不是商业太空数据中心投入运营，也没有独立性能验证。

narrative.en: The event date is disclosure day because Google’s article says only “this week” for the test. The October 1 launch is a different action; broader orbital AI services remain a research goal.
narrative.zhHans: 事件以披露日记载，因为谷歌只将测试描述为“本周”。10 月 1 日发射是另一行动；更广泛的在轨 AI 服务仍属研究目标。

text.en: On October 30 Google reported receiving a response generated on its prototype satellite by Gemma 4 running on an onboard TPU; the exact response day was not specified.
text.zhHans: 谷歌于 10 月 30 日报告收到原型卫星上由板载 TPU 运行的 Gemma 4 生成的回复；实际测试日期未指明。

text.en: The satellite launched on October 1; the later demonstration is a limited prototype test, not proof of a commercial orbital data center.
text.zhHans: 卫星于 10 月 1 日发射；之后的演示是有限的原型测试，不证明商业在轨数据中心已经建成。
